Description.value: Four ways to take a zombie off its feet, each in one of the game's own stumble animations: a leg hit as it lands on a fence or other narrow block, an arrow or bolt to the leg while it runs, a tire you have just put down in its path, and a door slammed in its face through DoorSlammer. Chances grow with weapon skill and are all tunable in-game. Compatible with Undead Legacy.
